# thalassa_endpoint (Data Source)

Get an endpoint by identity



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identity of the endpoint

### Optional

- `organisation_id` (String) Reference to the Organisation of the endpoint. If not provided, the organisation of the (Terraform) provider will be used.

### Read-Only

- `endpoint_address` (String) Address of the endpoint
- `endpoint_hostname` (String) Hostname of the endpoint
- `endpoint_port` (Number) Port of the endpoint
- `endpoint_protocol` (String) Protocol of the endpoint
- `endpoint_type` (String) Type of the endpoint (vpc or platform)
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of the endpoint
- `name` (String) Name of the endpoint
- `resource_identity` (String) Identity of the resource that the endpoint is attached to
- `resource_type` (String) Type of the resource that the endpoint is attached to
- `subnet_id` (String) Identity of the subnet that the endpoint belongs to
- `vpc_id` (String) Identity of the VPC that the endpoint belongs to
